gapped_lever_categories: Use USP-grade water with verified Pb, Cd, Al, and As specifications; municipal source-water quality varies and can contribute substantially to Al and Pb burden in a dilute aqueous product;Glucose-source supplier CoA: pharmaceutical-grade or USP-grade glucose carries tighter Pb, Cd, and As limits than food-grade glucose; corn-derived vs cane-derived glucose may differ in Cd burden;No complex formulation levers; product is glucose plus water; purity of both inputs is the dominant lever;Dabeka 2011 found Al means of 73 ng/g (glass-packed) up to 239 ng/g across Canadian samples; lot-level Al and Pb testing recommended; glass packaging associated with lower Al in this product class;Glass primary packaging associated with lower Al burden in Dabeka 2011 vs packaging-associated Al in non-glass formats; aluminum packaging migration is a relevant lever for this product class

Use USP-grade water with verified Pb, Cd, Al, and As specifications; municipal source-water quality is a meaningful variable for a dilute aqueous product;Mineral supplement inputs (sodium chloride, potassium chloride, zinc) should carry supplier CoA with Pb, Cd, As, and Al specifications; inorganic mineral salts can carry heavy-metal impurities depending on manufacturing process and source ore;Flavoring agents and colorants may introduce additional Pb or Cd; unflavoured formulations showed slightly higher Al than flavoured in Dabeka 2011, but both were low relative to glucose solution max; flavoring agent purity is a secondary lever;Lot-level Al and Pb testing recommended given that Al and Pb are the analytes with the most occurrence data in this product class; ICP-MS on finished product is appropriate;Primary packaging material (glass vs plastic vs foil-pouch) affects Al migration potential; glass associated with lower Al in comparable aqueous products in Dabeka 2011

For oat-based: source oat from suppliers with documented Cd and Pb specifications; oats can accumulate Cd from phosphate-fertilized soils; organic vs non-organic sourcing may affect Pb burden per Marques 2021 detection pattern;Lot-level ICP-MS testing for Pb, Cd, Ni, and tAs on finished beverage; particularly relevant given inter-variety variance (oat vs almond vs coconut carry different metal profiles)

Source soy from low-Cd soils; US soybean-origin Al means (176–758 µg/L in beverage) vary by soy input type (hydrosoluble vs soybean vs isolate); isolate-protein sources yielded lower mean Al in Milani 2023;For isolate-derived soy beverages: wet-process extraction reduces mineral carrythrough relative to whole-bean processing; affects Ni and Al;Lot-level finished-product ICP-OES or ICP-MS testing for Al, Ni, Cd, and Pb; Milani 2023 ICP-OES LOQs for tAs and Cd were high (191 ppb and 19 ppb respectively), so method selection affects detection capability;Non-canned format; aluminum packaging contact is not a primary contamination pathway for soy beverages in Tetra-Pak or glass formats
